Oncall-Bot: INCIDENT P1: embeddings-service (us-east-1) experiencing elevated 5xx rate ~18% for the last 3m. Severity: customer-impacting. Pager sent to #eng-oncall-night. Auto-escalation in 8m. Link: https://incidents.redwood/2477777777 :rotating_light:
Alex R: grabbing this as night primary. starting triage. any quick indicators in logs or recent deploys?
Mira S: saw an autoscaler flapping alert earlier but not sure if related. I can pull logs if you want.
Devon L: I can check the model variant rollout history — there was a canary pushed ~2h ago to embeddings-v3-quant.
Alex R: thanks. @Devon L can you confirm if rollout finished? if it did, let's rollback to embeddings-v3-quant-stable.
Devon L: rollout shows 60% -> 100% around 2:12am UTC. I see errors spike right after. rolling back now.
Alex R: good. I'm scaling up pool to mitigate backpressure: `rdpool scale embeddings-us-east-1 --count 6`
Sam P: copying runbook snippet for error-rate mitigation:
```
Runbook: Embeddings Service High Error Rate
1) Check recent rollouts: `rdctl rollouts list --svc embeddings`
2) If rollout in last hour: rollback to last stable tag: `rdctl rollout rollback --svc embeddings --to-tag stable`
3) Scale workers to 6-8 temporarily: `rdpool scale`
4) Disable prefix caching experiment: toggle in config `emb-cache.enabled=false`
5) File ticket with error samples and request traces
```
Kelsey T: rollback finished at 02:18 UTC per deploy bot. Can we watch for 5xx delta for next 5m?
Oncall-Bot: Deployment rollback event: embeddings-v3-quant -> embeddings-v3-quant-stable at 02:18 UTC by Devon L.
Alex R: 2m after rollback, 5xx dropped to 6%. still above normal but trending down. good sign.
Mira S: traffic note — APAC customers were routed to us-east due to region consolidation yesterday. potential capacity mismatch there.
Devon L: I see KV cache thrash in logs from a subset of requests hitting long sequences. added a temporary route to reduce max_seq to 2048 for heavy clients.
Alex R: tagging primary/secondary for next handoff: Mira will be day primary (06:00 UTC), Kelsey will be day secondary. I'm handing off now to prepare for transit.
Mira S: taking handoff. what's the short summary I should read out?
Alex R: summary: rollback of embeddings-v3-quant -> stable due to 5xx spike after rollout. scaled pool to 6. KV cache thrash observed on long sequences for some customers. current 5xx ~4.2% (was 18%). experiment flags toggled: emb-cache disabled for heavy route.
Mira S: got it. any outstanding mitigation steps I should own?
Alex R: please keep autoscale paused for 15m, monitor error rate vs median lat, and hold off on reintroducing the quant variant until the retro. Also confirm APAC routing plan with infra (ticket open).
Kelsey T: I'll watch alerts and prepare canary gating if we decide to try a safer rollout.
Sam P: filed ticket ENG-4321 with error samples, rollout diffs, and proposed mitigation (rollback + scale). linking here: https://tickets.redwood/ENG-4321
Nora B: scheduled a postmortem/retro for tomorrow 14:00 UTC, invite includes oncall, infra, and model team. calendar: https://calendar.redwood/event/retro-ENG-4321
Mira S: thanks. quick note on coverage gap — APAC oncall is still on rotation with only one person overnight. if we need region-level mitigation, we may have delayed response. opening a ticket for rotation coverage: OPS-209.
Alex R: agreed that's a follow-up action. add to postmortem action list.
Devon L: follow-up items I own: add canary gating to rollout pipeline (deadline EOD day after), and add a smoke test for long-sequence KV cache patterns.
Kelsey T: I'll update dashboards with a temporary emb-5xx alert threshold at 3% so it triggers earlier next time.
Sam P: note in ENG-4321: customer-impact assessment attached (20 customers affected, highest impact on embeddings-heavy plans).
Mira S: handoff checklist: I've documented current mitigations, owners, and links in the ticket and pinned it to the channel. I'll monitor for the next 4h and escalate to infra if 5xx > 5% sustained.
Alex R: thanks Mira. closing my oncall shift — ping me if things re-escalate. good job team :thumbsup:
Oncall-Bot: Hand-off logged: Alex R -> Mira S at 03:00 UTC. Next escalation window set 06:00 UTC.
Mira S: copy that, taking primary. Action items recap (from me): 1) monitor error rate & latency (Mira), 2) canary gating PR (Devon), 3) threshold dashboard update (Kelsey), 4) rotation coverage ticket (Nora), 5) postmortem scheduled (Nora).
Nora B: I'll own the rotation ticket and make sure the retro notes include timeline + rollback decision log. Also will follow up with legal for any customer notification if needed.
Sam P: marking ENG-4321 status = triaged -> in-progress. will update channel when we have detailed trace IDs.
Mira S: thanks all. leaving an explicit handoff note for the day shift: do not re-run the quant variant rollout until explicit sign-off from model team after retro.
Alex R: acknowledged. handoff complete.
Oncall-Bot: Thread closed for active paging. Leave a reaction to confirm you've read the handoff.
